name: coreidml
description: Read, edit, fill and lay out Adobe InDesign IDML files, export them to PDF and preview pages. No InDesign needed.
long_description:
CoreIdml gives Claude the tools to work on InDesign documents saved as IDML: summaries of pages, frames and stories; text edits and find and replace; filling templates from data; moving, resizing and duplicating items; adding, deleting and reordering pages; importing XML; merging documents; relinking images; checking whether text fits its frames; PDF export and page previews as images.

Every edit writes a new file (or replaces the original only when asked), and can be tried first as a dry run that reports the changes.

Give files by their full path (for example C:\Users\you\Documents\brochure.idml).
